title: Ruth Stays with Naomi
summary: Faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Ruth 1:16-18 and look for how this passage teaches: Faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard.

tell_it: Ruth chose to stay with Naomi and follow Naomi's God. Her loyal love became part of God's bigger story.
understand_it: Faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Ruth Stays with Naomi reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Faithfulness matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Ruth Stays with Naomi shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard.
teen_explanation: Ruth Stays with Naomi gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when faithfulness is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who did Ruth stay with?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Naomi. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Ruth 1:16 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Ruth Stays with Naomi?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Loyal Love Chain
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Ruth Stays with Naomi. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
